name: Civil Aircraft Mod (CAM)
summary: Freeware pack of AI civil airliners and light aircraft for DCS World missions.
description: Adds AI-only civil aircraft (A320, A380, 727, 737, 747, 757, Cessna 210 and liveries). Install into `Saved Games\DCS\Mods\aircraft`; units appear under Insurgents with the period filter off.
